name: Olark
description: Olark is a website live-chat platform for visitor conversations, operator workflows, chat transcripts, routing, automation, reporting, and CRM integrations.
agentUseSummary: Configure Olark's completed-transcript webhook to a Relay-generated opaque callback, then let selected agents use privacy-redacted transcript operational metadata under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: OLARK_RELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Relay Olark webhook secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a Relay-generated opaque callback secret because Olark's documented transcript webhook does not describe request signing.

webhookRequirements.purpose: Receive the documented completed transcript POST for privacy-redacted operational projection.

capabilities.label: Read transcript operations
capabilities.description: Project completed transcript webhook payloads into IDs, counts, and timestamps without messages, visitor identities, contact details, page history, custom fields, tags, group/operator identities, or raw payloads.

approvalRequired.label: Project transcript metadata
approvalRequired.description: Project one completed Olark transcript webhook into content-free operational counts and timestamps.

blocked.label: Use an Olark REST API
blocked.description: Olark's current official documentation does not publish an authenticated server REST API, so Relay does not invent one.

blocked.label: Execute browser JavaScript
blocked.description: Olark's JavaScript API controls a live visitor chatbox and is outside this Railway-backed webhook connector.

blocked.label: Read transcript content
blocked.description: Messages, notes, visitor/contact data, navigation, custom fields, tags, identities, and raw payloads are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every transcript projection requires approval; Relay ingress-secret isolation, payload bounds, content exclusion, and audits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Transcript projections run without Relay per-action approval; ingress-secret isolation, bounds, content exclusion, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway accepts bounded transcript webhook payloads through an opaque Relay-secret callback and mounts only the content-free projection.
Railway accepts bounded transcript webhook payloads through an opaque Relay-secret callback and mounts only the content-free projection.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer must configure Olark's completed-transcript webhook to the Relay-generated opaque callback; Olark does not document webhook request signing.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the opaque Relay callback in Olark, send a provider test transcript, verify content exclusion and Safe approval, rotate the Relay ingress secret, and verify old-callback and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Olark officially documents completed transcript HTTP POST webhooks with a JSON-encoded transcript and does not document a request signature in the guide.
Olark's official API documentation covers browser JavaScript chatbox and visitor APIs rather than an authenticated server REST API.
Olark documents paid-plan transcript access and CSV exports through its dashboard, not a server transcript read API.
